newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks drift at lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks drift at lower levels.

text.p: U.S. stocks moved sideways at lower levels on Thursday, as investors took some profits following declines in bonds and ambiguous economic data.
Financial markets were also cautious ahead of key employment data, due out on Friday.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was off around 32 points at 8223, while Nasdaq eased two points to 1586.
The long bond, which has started the session higher, dipped 1/32 to yield 6.33 percent.
Stocks and bonds were slightly thrown by a rise in the prices paid component of the Chicago PMI, analysts said.
